title: Derive a new value
summary: The $derived rune describes a value calculated from other state.
introduction: The $derived rune describes a value calculated from other state. Your task: Change ten pages per book to twelve.

Explain the example for derive a new value

blocks.text: The $derived rune describes a value calculated from other state. It stays connected to the values it uses.
Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.
Read the code step by step

items: `$state` marks a Svelte value as reactive so the page can follow its later changes.
`$derived` calculates a Svelte value from its dependencies. It is for derived values rather than outside side effects.

blocks.text: The page starts at 20 pages and increases by ten with each click.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep a derived expression focused on calculating a value, not changing another value.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change ten pages per book to twelve.
